# Entity

An entity is a struct in `ent/schema` that embeds `entlite.Schema`. The methods below are read from the source, they are never executed.

```go
package schema

type User struct {
	entlite.Schema
}

func (User) Contracts() []entlite.Contract { ... }
func (User) Fields() []entlite.Field       { ... }
func (User) Queries() []entlite.Query      { ... }
func (User) Indexes() []entlite.Index      { ... }
```

## Methods

| Method | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Contracts() []entlite.Contract` | yes | The layers the entity is generated for, sqlc, proto or both. |
| `Fields() []entlite.Field` | no | The columns of the entity, see the fields page. |
| `Queries() []entlite.Query` | no | The queries generated for the entity, see the queries page. |
| `Indexes() []entlite.Index` | no | The indexes of the table, see the indexes page. |

Only `Contracts()` is enforced, generation stops when it is missing or empty. An entity without `Fields()` still gets its `id` column.

## Marker interfaces

Each list holds one of these, the builder packages return them.

| Interface | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `entlite.Field` | Implemented by every field builder. |
| `entlite.Query` | Implemented by every query builder. |
| `entlite.Index` | Implemented by every index builder. |
| `entlite.Contract` | One output layer a field or query belongs to. |

## The id field

Every entity gets an `id` field, it is added by the parser when the schema does not declare one. An `index.Primary(...)` declares the primary key itself, so the generated `id` column is dropped and `query.Get()`, `query.Update()` and `query.Delete()` key on the index columns instead. A declared `id` field is kept, as a plain column.

Who fills the key in follows one rule: if an `index.Primary(...)` names a column, the caller supplies it, otherwise entlite does. So `index.Primary("id", "env")` puts `id` in the create request and leaves the insert with nothing to return, while a plain `id` is assigned by the database, or in Go when the field has a `DefaultFunc()`.
